[[File:Fanlanden map.jpg|140px|left|link=The eleventh house]]
'''[[The eleventh house]]''' is the oldest rumor in the realm: that the Ten Great Houses were once eleven. No chronicle asserts it. The rumor lives in miscounts — eleven banners, eleven lords on the cooling ground, a children's rhyme that counts ''…eight, nine, ten, and one who left.''
